# netbox_devices (Data Source)

Lists device objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_devices" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-device" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: asset_tag, asset_tag__empty, asset_tag__ic, asset_tag__ie, asset_tag__iew, asset_tag__iregex, asset_tag__isw, asset_tag__n, asset_tag__nic, asset_tag__nie, asset_tag__niew, asset_tag__nisw, asset_tag__regex, cluster_id, cluster_id__n, device_type_id, device_type_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, location_id, location_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, platform_id, platform_id__n, rack_id, rack_id__n, region, region__n, role_id, role_id__n, serial, serial__empty, serial__ic, serial__ie, serial__iew, serial__iregex, serial__isw, serial__n, serial__nic, serial__nie, serial__niew, serial__nisw, serial__regex, site_id, site_id__n, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The matching devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `airflow` (String) One of: front-to-rear, rear-to-front, left-to-right, right-to-left, side-to-rear, passive, mixed, rear-to-side, bottom-to-top, top-to-bottom.
- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `cluster_id` (Number) Id of the virtualization cluster the device hosts.
- `comments` (String)
- `config_template_id` (Number) Id of the config template.
- `console_port_count` (Number) Number of console ports on the device.
- `console_server_port_count` (Number) Number of console server ports on the device.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_bay_count` (Number) Number of device bays on the device.
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type.
- `front_port_count` (Number) Number of front ports on the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `interface_count` (Number) Number of interfaces on the device.
- `inventory_item_count` (Number) Number of inventory items on the device.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `local_context_data` (String) Local config context data as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location within the site.
- `module_bay_count` (Number) Number of module bays on the device.
- `name` (String) Device name; NetBox allows unnamed devices.
- `oob_ip_id` (Number) Id of the out-of-band management IP address (managed by netbox_device_oob_ip).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `platform_id` (Number) Id of the platform.
- `power_outlet_count` (Number) Number of power outlets on the device.
- `power_port_count` (Number) Number of power ports on the device.
- `primary_ip4_id` (Number) Id of the primary IPv4 address (managed by netbox_primary_ip).
- `primary_ip6_id` (Number) Id of the primary IPv6 address (managed by netbox_primary_ip).
- `rack_face` (String) Rack face the device is mounted on. One of: front, rear.
- `rack_id` (Number) Id of the rack.
- `rack_position` (Number) Lowest rack unit occupied by the device; half units (e.g. 1.5) are allowed.
- `rear_port_count` (Number) Number of rear ports on the device.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the device role.
- `serial` (String) Chassis serial number.
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: offline, active, planned, staged, failed, inventory, decommissioning.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_chassis_id` (Number) Id of the virtual chassis.
- `virtual_chassis_position` (Number) Position in the virtual chassis (0-255).
- `virtual_chassis_priority` (Number) Master election priority in the virtual chassis (0-255).
